title: Treatment of RAF1-Related Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy by MEK Inhibition Using Trametinib.
abstract: RASopathies cause nonsarcomeric hypertrophic cardiomyopathy via dysregulated signaling through RAS and upregulated mitogen-activated protein kinase activity. We provide the first report of the successful treatment of an adult with RAF1-associated hypertrophic cardiomyopathy using trametinib, a MEK inhibitor.
